Latin word

magna

magna (maxima) pars + gen.

noun phrase, with the genitive of the whole

a great part of, most of

In this lexicon

  • the top of

    also used · classical · Sen. Ep. 1.1: magna pars vītae

  • amita magna: great-aunt

    classical

  • mātertera magna: great-aunt

    classical

  • ē rīvō flūmina magna facere: make a mountain out of a molehill

    classical

Examples

  • magna pars vītae ēlābitur male agentibus, maxima nihil agentibus, tōta vīta aliud agentibus

    a great part of life slips away from those who do wrong, most of it from those who do nothing, the whole of it from those who do something elseSen. Ep. 1.1
